name: Biomedical Sciences Graduate Program (PhD)
detailsNote: Official information available; 2027 entry dates not explicitly confirmed. Summer entry only; international sponsor requirement differs from rotation-based cohort route, so a single admission model is omitted.

english.note: Official scores within two years sent by application deadline; if received valid, expiry before entry does not invalidate admission proof. No MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Citizenship/degree from listed countries or US permanent-resident/asylee/refugee status over one year may exempt; overseas English-medium instruction alone does not. Higher program minima control; TA and writing assessments separate.

applicationFee.note: International 70 USD; US 60 USD. Conditional recruitment-code or preapproved departmental payment routes; international eligibility should be confirmed. Economic-disadvantage, FreeApp and SROP categories exclude international applicants. Waiver approved or fee paid before admission; one per year and no refund after payment.

documents: Personal statement (generally one page) on background, research and career goals
Reference letters submitted through system; count not established on opened pages
Scans of official transcripts for review; official complete records and degrees after offer
requirements.note: Summer entry only: select Summer in application. Natural-science undergraduate preparation preferred, including biology, chemistry/biochemistry, physiology, genetics, physics and calculus; research experience required, one hypothesis-driven year preferred. GPA 3.0 minimum. International applicants must secure faculty commitment to stipend, tuition and fees for 5+years before applying; FAQ also describes rare admission without this, so confirm. International route differs from first-year domestic cohort support.

funding.note: All incoming students first-year stipend/tuition/fees commitment on admissions overview; FAQ excludes internationals from program first-year funds and requires their own faculty sponsor for 5+years. International coverage depends on secured sponsor. No unconditional program funding promise to internationals.
